_meta.description: The nine areas offered in onboarding's 'Where are you staying?' step.
_meta.usage: Selecting an area sets the distance anchor. All spot distances are recomputed at runtime with haversine from that area's `center`, replacing the precomputed `distanceFromStayKm` baseline in bali-spots.json.
_meta.note: Onboarding also allows a free-form Google Places search. A custom location produces the same anchor shape ({ lat, lng }) and works identically.

stayAreas.label: Ubud
stayAreas.blurb: Rice fields, river gorges and temples. Best base for central Bali.

stayAreas.label: Canggu
stayAreas.blurb: Surf breaks, cafés and a young crowd. Scooter country.

stayAreas.label: Seminyak
stayAreas.blurb: Beach clubs, restaurants and shopping. Polished and walkable.

stayAreas.label: Sanur
stayAreas.blurb: Calm water and a flat beach path. The Nusa ferry port is here.

stayAreas.label: Uluwatu
stayAreas.blurb: Clifftop sunsets and world-class surf on the southern tip.

stayAreas.label: Nusa Dua
stayAreas.blurb: Resort enclave with calm swimming beaches and quiet streets.

stayAreas.label: Sidemen
stayAreas.blurb: Terraced valley under Mount Agung. Ubud thirty years ago.

stayAreas.label: Amed
stayAreas.blurb: Black sand, freediving and the calmest water on the island.

stayAreas.label: Lovina
stayAreas.blurb: Sleepy north coast, dolphin boats and easy waterfall access.
